hook.name: PortXHook
hook.description: A two-phase meme token launch hook for the PortX platform. During the bonding curve phase it NoOps the core AMM entirely, pricing trades against a virtual-reserve constant-product curve with a 1% fee; after the curve sells out, it graduates the pool to a standard AMM and continues charging a 1% fee on all swaps via delta returns. External liquidity addition and removal are permanently blocked.
